# pizzasim_pizza (Resource)

The `pizzasim_pizza` resource allows you to create, update, and delete pizzas in the PizzaSim API. Each pizza has a name, list of ingredients, price, and optional description.

## Example Usage

### Basic Pizza

```terraform
resource "pizzasim_pizza" "margherita" {
  name        = "Margherita"
  ingredients = ["tomato sauce", "mozzarella", "basil"]
  price       = 12.99
  description = "Classic Italian pizza"
}
```

### Pizza with Default Description

```terraform
resource "pizzasim_pizza" "pepperoni" {
  name        = "Pepperoni"
  ingredients = ["tomato sauce", "mozzarella", "pepperoni"]
  price       = 14.99
}
```

### Gourmet Pizza with Multiple Ingredients

```terraform
resource "pizzasim_pizza" "quattro_formaggi" {
  name = "Quattro Formaggi"
  ingredients = [
    "tomato sauce",
    "mozzarella",
    "gorgonzola",
    "parmesan",
    "ricotta"
  ]
  price       = 16.99
  description = "Four cheese pizza"
}
```

### Multiple Pizzas

```terraform
resource "pizzasim_pizza" "hawaiian" {
  name        = "Hawaiian"
  ingredients = ["tomato sauce", "mozzarella", "ham", "pineapple"]
  price       = 13.99
  description = "Controversial but delicious"
}

resource "pizzasim_pizza" "vegetarian" {
  name = "Vegetarian"
  ingredients = [
    "tomato sauce",
    "mozzarella",
    "bell peppers",
    "mushrooms",
    "olives",
    "onions"
  ]
  price       = 13.49
  description = "Fresh veggie pizza"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the pizza. Must be between 3 and 50 characters and unique within your configuration.
- `ingredients` (Set of String) List of ingredients on the pizza. Must contain at least 1 ingredient and at most 20 ingredients.
- `price` (Number) Price of the pizza in dollars. Must be between 0.01 and 100.00.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the pizza. Defaults to "Created by your Infra" if not specified.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the pizza. This is the same as the pizza name.
- `last_baked` (String) Timestamp of when the pizza was last baked (created or updated) in RFC3339 format.

## Import

Pizzas can be imported using their name:

```shell
terraform import pizzasim_pizza.margherita "Margherita"
```

After importing, you can run `terraform plan` to see any differences between the imported state and your configuration.

## Attribute Validation

The resource enforces the following validations:

- **name**: 3-50 characters
- **ingredients**: 1-20 items in the set
- **price**: Between $0.01 and $100.00
- **description**: Optional, defaults to "Created by your Infra"

If validation fails, Terraform will show an error with details about the constraint violation.
